bookTitle: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis

facts.statement: The hammer candle is one of the three premier VPA candles representing market strength, forming when price falls significantly during a session before buyers absorb the selling pressure and force the price back up to close near the open.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The hammer is the second of our three 'premier' candles... It is the classic candle of strength, for either temporary strength, or as a signal for longer term price reversal.

facts.topic: Hammer Structure and the 'No Anomaly' Rule
facts.statement: A hammer features a narrow real body concentrated at the top, a long lower wick, and little to no upper wick; body color is irrelevant, and just like shooting stars, there is never an anomaly with a hammer candle.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The same points apply to the hammer candle. Once again, there is NEVER an anomaly with a hammer candle. The price action tells us all we need to know.

facts.statement: While a single hammer on high volume warns of strength, a sequence of two or three hammers accompanied by high or ultra-high volume validates a buying climax where insiders restock warehouses from panic sellers.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The power of the hammer candle... is revealed, once we see a sequence of two or three of these candles accompanied by high or extremely high volume. It is at this point we know, for sure that we are in the realms of a buying climax.

facts.statement: During fast price waterfalls, insiders briefly step in to buy and create hammers that trigger short squeezes, forcing short-sellers to cover and shaking out sellers to offload higher-cost stock before resuming the markdown.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: In a fast price waterfall, the hammer represents 'forced buying' by insiders to temporarily support the market... This squeeze forces weak short-sellers to cover and shakes out obstinate sellers.

facts.statement: A low-volume hammer signals a minor temporary pause (giving shorts confidence to hold), an average-volume hammer suggests a moderate bounce, and a high to ultra-high volume hammer signals heavy professional money buying and impending reversal.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: A low-volume hammer: signals a temporary pause... Average-volume hammer: suggests stronger potential for a moderate bounce... High to ultra-high volume hammer: signals massive professional money intervention.

facts.statement: A hanging man has the exact structural shape of a hammer but appears at the top of an established bull trend, serving as an early warning sign of bearish weakness when confirmed by above-average or high volume.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: A candle with the exact visual construction of a hammer... that occurs at the top of an established bullish trend... a hanging man is a sign of potential weakness.

facts.statement: Coulling compares the financial market to a massive supertanker possessing heavy momentum that takes time and distance to respond once brakes like stopping volume or hammer candles are applied.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Like a massive supertanker, it possesses heavy momentum and takes time and distance to respond once the brakes (stopping volume / hammer candles) are applied.

facts.topic: Honeywell and Silver ETF Case Studies
facts.statement: On the Honeywell daily chart, a sharp sell-off was halted by stopping volume and a high-volume hammer confirming insider absorption; similarly, a Silver ETF 5-minute chart saw narrow down bars on extreme volume followed by a hammer.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Honeywell (HON) Daily Chart: A sharp sell-off was halted when stopping volume appeared, followed immediately by a high-volume hammer candle... Silver ETF (SLV) 5-Minute Chart: A price decline produced narrow down bars on extreme volume.

facts.statement: A sustained multi-month AUD/USD price waterfall ended in a classic buying climax where panic selling was absorbed by a high-volume hammer, followed by low-volume test candles prior to an 18-month bull trend.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: AUD/USD Weekly Chart (Buying Climax): A sustained multi-month price waterfall ended in a classic buying climax, where panic selling was absorbed by a hammer candle on high volume.

facts.topic: Core VPA Rules Summary for Hammers
facts.statement: Traders must focus on lower wicks first to gauge price rejection, let volume determine the potential distance of the move, exercise patience rather than trading single candles blindly, and recognize that location dictates meaning.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Focus on Wicks First... Volume Determines Extent... Patience Over Action... Location is Everything.

generalAssumptions: Market price manipulation is structurally transparent on the volume tape.
Effort versus result governs institutional capital movement.
